_readme: Things the card API cannot tell us, so a human has to. Everything here is
optional: leave a set out and its page simply omits those bits rather than
inPrint    short answer shown as a fact tile, e.g. 'Yes' / 'Sealed only'
packPrice  typical single booster price you actually see, e.g. '$4.99'
funFacts   array of extra lines for the 101 section, in your own words
The pages already derive their own facts from the card data (counts,
rarity ladder, chase card). These are for what only you know.
